1. There is no voltage between ECU terminals STA and E1.
(IG SW START)

Check starter operation.
OK → Check wiring between ECU terminal STA and ignition switch terminal ST1.
BAD → OK → BAD → Repair or replace.

2. Check wiring between ECU terminal E1 and body ground.
OK → Try another ECU.
BAD → Repair or replace.

Check fusible links, battery, wiring, ignition switch and neutral start switch.
BAD → Repair or replace.
OK ↓

3. Check that there is voltage at terminal 50 of starter.
(IG SW START)    STD voltage:  6 — 14 V
OK → Check starter.
NO → Check wiring between ignition switch terminal ST1 and starter terminal 50.
